idea-plugin.name: JPA 3D
idea-plugin.description:
Visualize your JPA Entity model as an interactive 3D / 2D ERD inside the IDE.

Features
  • 3D force-directed graph & 2D orthogonal ERD (elkjs layered layout)
  • Cardinality detection for @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, @OneToOne, @ManyToMany
  • Bidirectional relationship deduplication (drops mappedBy mirror edges)
  • Spring Data Repository → Entity mapping (JpaRepository, CrudRepository, etc.)
  • Column metadata: PK, nullable, unique, length, @GeneratedValue strategy
  • @MappedSuperclass / @Embeddable visualization with EXTENDS edges
  • Java & Kotlin support via UAST — handles Kotlin's annotation use-site targets transparently
  • Both jakarta.persistence and legacy javax.persistence packages

Open the JPA 3D tool window on the right side after the project is indexed.

한국어: JPA Entity 모델을 IDE 안에서 3D / 2D ERD 로 시각화합니다. Java/Kotlin, jakarta & javax persistence, Spring Data Repository 매핑까지 자동 분석합니다.
